question_or_proposition: In the Section B.1 cyanide compliance schedule, does the activity 'Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date' establish a transition between different enforceable numeric cyanide limits at that date, or only a deadline by which the permittee must meet limits otherwise specified elsewhere in the permit without changing which limits apply during the preceding 12-month period?
required_context: Cyanide effluent limitations specified for discharges referenced in Section B.1
Whether interim and final cyanide limits are distinguished elsewhere in the permit
Federal FY2025 monitoring and reporting periods relative to the 12-month compliance date
Section B.1 sub-items (a)-(c) progress report and compliance notice requirements
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, page 6, section part_i, Section B.1 compliance schedule activity line
notes: The nominated clause sits within the cyanide compliance schedule and is adjoined by reporting obligations tied to achievement of final limitations. Resolving whether it governs limit applicability over time or only a compliance deadline affects which cyanide limits are enforceable for FY2025 comparisons and whether schedule-linked reporting obligations remained applicable during that period.
